keyPoints.descZh: 否定回答：口吃不影响智力

q1.rubricZh: 要点：回答 No，口吃不影响聪明程度。
q1.explanationZh: 第一部分说很多聪明人也口吃，口吃只和大脑的某个区域有关，并不影响智力。所以答 No。

q2.sampleAnswer: Be patient, don’t cut them off, and wait for them to finish.

keyPoints.descZh: 耐心、不打断、等对方说完
examples: Be patient and don’t cut them off.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：耐心，不打断，等他说完。
q2.explanationZh: 第二部分告诉我们：要有耐心，不要打断他们，等他们把话说完。

evidence.quote: Be patient and don’t cut them off.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because stuttering is not a habit that one can easily stop. It is linked to a certain area of the brain.

keyPoints.descZh: 口吃不是能轻易停下的习惯，与大脑某区域有关
examples: Because one can’t easily stop stuttering.
Because it is linked to a certain area of the brain.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：不能轻易停止，或与大脑某区域有关。
q3.explanationZh: 第三部分说口吃不是习惯，因为人不能轻易让它停下来，而且口吃还和大脑有关。

q4.sampleAnswer: To help them build up the confidence to speak.

keyPoints.descZh: 帮助口吃的人建立说话的信心
examples: To help them build up the confidence to speak.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：建立说话的信心（而不是治愈）。
q4.explanationZh: 文章最后说，言语治疗不保证治好，主要是帮助口吃的人有信心开口说话。

evidence.quote: They are more about helping the person to build up the confidence to speak.

q5.explanationZh: 文章第一句就说国际口吃宣传日是每年的10月22日。

q6.sampleAnswer: I can listen to him patiently and never laugh at his speaking. I can also encourage him to share his ideas.(Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 给出合理的帮助方法（开放题）
examples: I can listen to him patiently.
I can encourage him to share his ideas.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，只要方法合理、与文章建议相符即可，如耐心倾听、不打断、不嘲笑、鼓励他表达。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。可以照文章的建议：耐心听他说完、不打断他、不笑他，再多鼓励他说出自己的想法。

evidence.quote: So let them know that they can trust you.
